title: A review child's slash-command arguments lose everything before a literal " -- " in the scope text
outcome: Scope text passed to a /review-code child arrives intact even when it contains " -- " (as git diff path lists do), so a review round is not wasted on a lost file list.
acceptance: The cause is located and named: which layer (the spawn API, argument tokenizing, or the command template) drops the text before " -- ".
A test passes a scope containing " -- " through the same path a /review-changes round uses, and shows the child receives the complete text, both for a Codex child and for a Claude child.
Existing argument handling without " -- " is unchanged.
